issues.current_text: O Exército americano recebeu o primeiro Black Hawk autônomo, o H-60Mx, equipado com o software MATRIX da Sikorsky — derivado do programa ALIAS do DARPA — com transições entre voo tripulado e totalmente autônomo.
issues.previous_text: O Exército dos EUA recebeu o primeiro Black Hawk autônomo, o UH-60Mx com fly-by-wire da Sikorsky.
issues.suggestion: Cut entirely. This was already covered on 03-21. The only new detail (MATRIX software name, ALIAS program origin) is not a new development — it's the same delivery event.

issues.current_text: O mesmo Exército encomendou 2.500 drones Skydio X10D por US$52mi, a maior compra de drones táticos de um único fabricante na história, com contrato fechado em menos de 72 horas.

issues.suggestion: Cut entirely. Identical story covered yesterday with the same numbers, same 72-hour detail. No new development.

issues.current_text: A SB Energy, do SoftBank, vai construir um datacenter de 10GW sobre o antigo complexo de armas nucleares de Piketon, Ohio — com 10GW de nova geração e um upgrade de US$4,2bi na rede, energia prevista para 2029.
issues.previous_text: O SoftBank inaugurou em Ohio o que Masayoshi Son chamou de 'o centro de nossa superinteligência': um data center de 10GW com usina a gás de $33,3bi — nove reatores nucleares em equivalência — sobre o antigo complexo de enriquecimento de urânio da Guerra Fria.
issues.suggestion: Cut or drastically reduce. The SoftBank 10GW Ohio datacenter on the former nuclear site was covered in detail on 03-21. The only new datapoint is the $4.2B grid upgrade and 2029 timeline — if worth keeping, fold into a single clause referencing the prior story rather than re-presenting it as news.

summary: High repetition. Three stories (Black Hawk, Skydio X10D, SoftBank Ohio datacenter) are straight repeats from 03-21/03-23 with no meaningful new developments. The Iran/oil section rehashes yesterday's lead. Phrasing overlaps are heavy ('despencou', 'negou qualquer', 'primeiro Black Hawk autônomo'). The 'agentic race', 'infrastructure can't keep up', and 'military autonomy roundup' frames have run in every edition this week.
